rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act - Notice Requirements
rules.quote: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires ALL LANDLORDS planning to end a tenancy agreement to provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources. The Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources should be delivered at the same time as the Notice to quit or Notice of non-renewal of lease.
rules.summary: All landlords planning to end a tenancy must provide tenants with a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as delivering a Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease.
rules.coverage_text: ALL LANDLORDS planning to end a tenancy agreement
rules.penalty: 1st Offense: Warning; 2nd and Subsequent Offenses: $300 per day
